tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: OPERATION & MAINTENANCE FOR FIVE YEARS OF MULTI VILLGE WATER SUPPLY SCHEME TO ENROUTE VILLAGES OF KADUR AND TARIKERE TALUKS IN CHIKKAMAGALRU DIST

itemList.description:
OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE for 1st Year to 5th Year: Operation and Maintenance of the Scheme as per TOR Which includes Providing Sufficient technical staff valve man, Operators, Electrician and Others who are required to run the system in Complete manner and providing all materials chemicals required for operation of Headworks/WTP/Pipe line repair Works.1) Regular Maintenance of Civil Structures like Headworks, WTP, Pure water sump, Master Balancing reservoir, Zonal Balancing Tank, Pump Houses, Control rooms, DI Unit rooms and all Other Civil Structure. The Maintenance Consist of all kinds of repair to damaged structures cleaning & Washing and Painting for civil structures once in a year All the infrastructure Must be Maintained in good working Condition through out the year so as to Ensure Unistarupted water supply to all the habitation through out the year & Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line, valves etc. if found necessary in includes cost of materials and labour Charges and also monitoring of the systems the Maintenance involves raw water Rising main, Gravity Mains, pure water rising mains, maintaining the required discharge the quantum at water in each pipe.  Maintenance the quality of water as per the guidelines CPHEEO Manual and ISI Specifications including cost of testing of water @ laboratory twice in a month. The bidder shall quote for the 5year O & M cost against the total estimated cost of Rs.18066183.00 The year wise breakup amount shall be calculated as the percentage given below.  
Year 1: 18.10%  
Year 2: 19.00%
Year 3: 19.95%
Year 4: 20.95%
Year 5: 22.00%
